leadText:
Nancy (Japanese: ナミコ Namiko) is a character of the day who appeared in The Evolutionary War!.

Nancy lives on Island C, one of the A-B-C Islands. She attends school over on Island A. Unlike many on Island C, she prefers over . Because of this, she had a rivalry with , from Island B, who prefers Huntail.

She and joined Professor Birch's visits to Islands C and B to discover more about and its branched Evolution. After Birch learned that the islands' waters contained Deep Sea Scale or Deep Sea Tooth extract, Nancy tagged along again. On Island C Nancy located a Deep Sea Tooth and gave it to Keith. Likewise, Keith ended up finding a Deep Sea Scale on Island B and gave it to Nancy, and she used it to evolve her Clamperl into her desired Gorebyss.

Everyone returned to the Pokémon Center on Island A, and netted Gorebyss while Nancy admired her new Pokémon. helped combat the evil trio and recovered Nancy's Gorebyss. Nancy and Keith joined forces and helped to defeat Team Rocket with their Gorebyss and Huntail, respectively. Afterwards, Nancy showcased her Gorebyss which helped settle the A-B-C Islands' biggest conflict over whether Gorebyss or Huntail was better.
